description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

The end is nigh, or so you fervently believe. You may have a specific apocalypse in mind, or the details might dier from day to day. You have an urge to share this revelation with everyone. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.oGbDwnLOn3isPJpO]{Impassioned Zeal} Talent. Make an Average (+20) Cool Test when you wake up every morning. If you pass you feel that the approaching doom can wait another day, but if you fail you must tell the world (if theres no one else, then your present company will have to su ce) of whats to come sometime during the day. Such a sermon will take at least 30, impassioned, minutes. If you do not tell the world about the imminent plight you'll automatically fail any Rest Test of that night as you toss and turn, and gain 1 @Condition[Fatigued] Condition the following day. People, especially witch hunters, around you may take note of any erratic behaviour (see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-mutations.mutations-journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}).
